codeReview.summary: Trip list rendering, Firestore reads, empty/loading states, and trip-card navigation are implemented, but the sync endpoint is hardcoded to localhost instead of the required /api/strava/sync route contract.

issues.description: Sync uses `fetch('http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync', ...)` instead of calling the required `/api/strava/sync` route. This hardcodes a dev-only host and violates the feature contract.
Test expectation hardcodes `http://localhost:5001/api/strava/sync`, which reinforces the route-contract mismatch and will fail once the endpoint is corrected to `/api/strava/sync`.
